description: List the community entries (user-published content, neblla.community) of an app from the backoffice, any status. Use it to triage the moderation queue: status "pending" is what awaits approval in review mode. Returns indexed metadata only (title, summary, category, tags, contentType, owner, status, moderation record, and stats: favorites, rating, reviews, uses, upvotes, downvotes, score); fetch a payload with neblla_get_community_entry. Paginate with `cursor` = the previous `next`.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous call

env.description: Whose data: "pro" (the users', default) or "pre" (the app's pre, its own users and data unless it plays with pro's)

ownerId.description: Filter by author. This is the SAME per-app user id that neblla_list_users and neblla_search_users_by_email return (entry.owner.id is that id), so you can go straight from a user to everything they published — no name matching needed.

q.description: Text search over title / summary / tags

sort.description: Pending entries come most serious first by default (each carries `priority`: notice > serious > reports > prescreen > review); newest/oldest for plain date order; votes: most voted first (stats.score = votes for minus votes against)

status.description: Filter by status (omit for all): published, pending (awaits approval), rejected, removed, suspended (a formal notice is open), private (only its author sees it)

name: neblla_list_community_entries
title: List community entries
